$schema.description: JSON Schema for editor completions. Ignored by Warden.

schemas.description: Postgres schemas Warden introspects. The first is the default schema: its tables are referred to by bare name, others as "schema.table".

defaults.description: Defaults for tables, columns, reads, deletes and reasons.

expose.description: all: every introspected table, minus hidden ones. none: only tables listed under tables.

newColumns.description: How columns with no entry under tables.<table>.columns are treated: visible, hidden (as if hidden: true), or readOnly.

read.description: all: everyone who can sign in may read every exposed table. granted: reading a table requires a read grant.

delete.description: Hard deletes. none: refused on every table unless it sets allowDelete: true. granted: a role's delete grant on a table is honored. "*" never grants delete.

requireReason.description: Writes that must say why (an internal note, stored in the audit log), on tables that don't set their own requireReason. [] makes reasons optional.

reasonMinLength.description: The shortest required reason, in characters after trimming, so "." or "fix" doesn't count.

sharedViews.description: Where shared grid views come from. config: only tables.<table>.views. ui: only views shared in the UI. both: either.

tables.description: Per-table config, keyed by "table" (default schema) or "schema.table".

hidden.description: Remove the table completely: it doesn't appear anywhere, and requesting it returns the same 404 as a table that doesn't exist.

label.description: The name shown in the UI.

displayField.description: Column used to represent this table's rows elsewhere, such as foreign key links and pickers.

defaultSort.description: The grid's initial sort, and the order of API lists and exports that don't name one.

columnOrder.description: Columns the grid shows first, left to right; the rest follow in the default order.

searchable.description: Columns the grid's free-text search matches against. Default: every visible text column.

columns.description: Per-column config, keyed by column name.

hidden.description: Remove the column completely: never selected, returned, shown, or accepted as input.

readOnly.description: Show the column but never accept writes to it.

label.description: The name shown in the UI.

readableBy.description: Only these roles see the column; to everyone else it is hidden.

writableBy.description: Only these roles may write the column; everyone else sees it read-only. Each must also be in readableBy when both are set.

deny.description: Actions nobody may perform on this table, whatever their roles grant. Beats every grant.

allowDelete.description: Turn hard delete on (true) or off (false) for this table, overriding defaults.delete. A role still needs delete on the table by name, and a deny that includes delete wins.

requireReason.description: Writes on this table that must say why, stored in the audit log. Overrides defaults.requireReason either way ([] makes reasons optional here).

updatablePrimaryKey.description: Let updates change primary key columns. A new key gives the row a new record id and splits its audit history. Only for natural keys that really do change.

insertablePrimaryKey.description: Let creates set primary key columns that have a default (sequence, identity, or default expression). An explicit key doesn't advance the sequence.

views.description: Shared grid views of this table, read-only in the UI.

key.description: Stable id, unique across all tables. Links use ?view=config:<key>, so keep it stable.

name.description: Shown in the Views menu and the sidebar.

filter.description: A filter, as the list endpoint takes it: { field, op, value }, or { and: [...] }, { or: [...] }, { not: ... } around others. Checked at startup.

sort.description: The sort, as { column, direction: asc | desc }.

columns.description: Visible columns, in the grid's usual order. Without it, every column is shown.

sidebar.description: Give the view its own entry in the sidebar, under Queues.

default.description: Apply this view when the table is opened without other grid state. One per table.

softDelete.description: Deleting a row sets column instead of removing it, under the same delete grant. Deleted rows are left out of lists unless asked for; roles granted update may restore them.

column.description: Set on delete: a timestamp to now(), a boolean to true.

by.description: Set to the actor's user id (see actor) on delete, null without one; cleared on restore.

roles.description: Roles grant actions on tables. Create, update and delete are denied unless a role grants them.

grants.description: Actions this role may perform, keyed by table ("users", "billing.invoices") or "*" for every exposed table. "*" can't grant delete.

admin.description: Warden administration areas this role may use: schema (drift page), audit (audit log), roles (assigning roles), views (sharing and managing shared views).

actions.description: Custom actions this role may run, or "*" for all. Running one doesn't need the table grants it writes with, but a table's deny still disables it.
Per custom action (from WARDEN_ACTIONS), settings that override the action's own.

disabled.description: Nobody may run it, whatever their roles grant.

requireReason.description: Whether running it must say why. Overrides the action's own requireReason either way; a table's requireReason covering a write the action may make still requires one.

access.description: Required. Who may sign in, and which roles they get, from the claims in the ID token.

groupsClaim.description: ID token claim holding the user's groups: a list of strings, or one string.

groups.description: Roles for each IdP group. Group names match exactly.

emailDomains.description: Roles for everyone whose email is at each domain (exact match, not subdomains; ASCII, punycode for internationalized domains).

requireVerifiedEmail.description: Only match emailDomains and role assignments, and only record the email, when the IdP says it is verified (email_verified: true). Turn off only for IdPs that never send the claim and don't let users set their own email.

allowAll.description: Let in everyone the IdP authenticates, with no roles unless a rule or assignment gives some. Only for IdPs that already restrict who can sign in.

audit.description: Where the audit log is written.

store.description: warden: warden.audit_log. table: a table you own, named by audit.table.

table.description: "table" (in the first of schemas) or "schema.table". Required with store: table.

columns.description: The column each audit field is written to. Leave it out to use warden.audit_log's column names.

source.description: Tags Warden's entries (column = value), for a table that also holds the application's own.

actor.description: Maps each signed-in user to a row of your own users table, by verified email, so audit entries record their internal user id.

table.description: The users table: "table" (in the first schema) or "schema.table". It may be hidden.

matchColumn.description: Text column matched, ignoring case, against the user's verified email.

idColumn.description: Column whose value (as text) is recorded as the actor's user id.

required.description: Deny sign-in to users with no single matching row, and to everyone if the mapping is broken.
